_comment: Examples of the bare-file-name rule for payload names, read by the Rust spec test and the Ignition test so both implementations agree. A name is bare when it cannot leave the package directory and opens an ordinary file on Linux and on Windows (no separators, drive or stream colon, NUL, dot segments, trailing dot or space, Windows device names with any extension). Names longer than 255 bytes are refused too (generated in the tests).
